g.text: One family, two exact numerical paths
Fixed degree and union-support multipliers; original equations and domains remain in the solver.
Shared metadata: p, variables, D, common equations U, parameter pencil T(z)
Freeze monomial columns and generator multiples once per cold workload. Keep full originals.
Fresh reference
Shared candidate
For every target z:
1. Specialize each generator once
2. Assemble all rows [ U ; T(z) ]
3. Fresh exact row reduction
Metadata constructor performs no numerical
RREF or coefficient projection. Same envelope
and row-reduction policy as the candidate.
Once: reduce U to [ I | B ]
Project each coefficient: Rk = Ck - Ak B
Per target: R(z) = sum z^k Rk
Recombine first, then reduce the residual
Recompute pivots at each z; rank drops are valid.
Project using integer, FMA, or exact split16.
Same finite-degree row space; downstream F4 retains originals and verifies witnesses
Cold cost includes all setup. Diagram describes construction; it contains no measured speed comparison.
